text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Smart-routing policy 'tiered-lane-v2' showing sustained 95th% latency > 1.2s for eu-central customers for last 6m. Error rate stable. Paging on-call.
alice_j: oncall here — looking at dashboards now. linking trace set and topo.
sam_t: seeing a big bump in economy lane qdepth and long tail on gen endpoints. Paid tiers (standard/premium) OK so far.
kai_ops: confirmed. Traffic spike from a single client IP block in eu-central repeating patterns. Smart routing is sending more to economy lane due to cost pressure heuristics.
ashley_devex: any customer-facing impact? have we seen SLO breaches for paid customers?
maria_sre: no paid SLOs breached yet but latency drifting might impact short tail soon. Recommend immediate protective action: throttle offending source + dampen economy steering for eu-central.
alice_j: agree. Paging pagerduty to escalate and apply mitigations.
pagerduty_bot: Incident acknowledged by alice_j. Next steps: triage -> mitigate -> handoff. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/infra/runbooks/smart-routing
sam_t: quick mitigation suggestions:
- apply per-source rate limit (ip block)
- temporarily disable economy steering in eu-central (force standard fallback)
- add short circuit for repeated small requests
kai_ops: prepping commands. will apply a soft dampening policy (scale economy weight down to 0.15 for eu-central) and add a per-src rps cap 5 for offending prefix.
kai_ops: running:
```
# set dampening weight
redwoodctl routing update-policy --name tiered-lane-v2 --region eu-central --set economy_weight=0.15 --reason "emergency dampen: latency spike"
# apply per-source rate limit for prefix
redwoodctl ratelimit create --scope prefix:203.0.113.0/24 --limit 5rps --duration 15m --reason "automated mitigation"
```
alice_j: executing with canary (5% of control plane) then promote if green.
kai_ops: canary applied at 1750001260. Observability: dropping economy qdepth by ~40% in canary.
sam_t: logs show offending client now under rate limit; tail latency improved in canary.
maria_sre: rolling to 100% region apply now. also setting temporary override to route standard tier for all requests with latency-sensitive flag.
ashley_devex: leaving a short customer note draft in #support-drafts in case we need to notify affected customers (economy tier only).
alice_j: tagging legal & compliance for audit trail. Also creating a short postmortem placeholder.
kai_ops: mitigation completed at 1750001302. metrics: 95p latency down from 1.25s -> 0.42s in eu-central, overall token throughput stable.
sam_t: adding a fallback rule to keep economy disabled for this prefix for 1 hour.
(brief note: the two triple-backtick blocks above are part of the same thread message string)
alice_j: next: confirm no regressions in other regions and schedule a short config hardening to prevent policy oscillation (feedback loop where cost heuristics overweight short-term spikes).
maria_sre: handoff to night oncall in 30m. I'll include mitigation steps and commands in the incident tracker and set retention on logs.
alice_j: I'm handing off to @kai_ops for the 20:00->08:00 shift. kai, please escalate if behaviour resumes.
kai_ops: acknowledged — will monitor dashboards and set alert for economy qdepth > 70th percentile sustained 2m.
ashley_devex: created support note for customers on impacted economy lane with suggested retry/backoff guidance.
alice_j: final note: action items — (1) add guard to smarts routing to detect single-source bursts and auto-dampen, (2) tune backoff window, (3) postmortem in 24h with root cause analysis.
maria_sre: closing pagerduty incident if no further alerts in 45m. tagging this thread with incident id INC-1750001 for tracking.
